summary: Array parameter of any non-templated builtin object type (SamplerState, SamplerComparisonState, ByteAddressBuffer) rejected as incomplete; templated ones fine. Order-dependent lazy type completion - any earlier declaration requiring completeness suppresses it. Clean through v1.6.2112, regressed v1.7.2207. SPIR-V half is older: v1.6.2104 emits the same invalid module and exits 0, so that boundary is a SPIRV-Tools upgrade.
title: Variable has incomplete type 'SamplerState [2]'
